title: EUSR-GAN: code for ultrasound super-resolution and the effect of interpolated references on its evaluation
description: Code for the manuscript EUSR-GAN: A lightweight multi-scale GAN for ultrasound super-resolution and the effect of interpolated references on its evaluation: CAMUS and BUSI experiments under the protocol of Ahmad et al. and at native resolution, the re-implementation of Ahmad et al., EDSR-baseline and SwinIR-light baselines, ablations, task-based and wavelet analyses, figure generation, and a web prototype.
